description: This file implements a local cache layer for user data in the Mattermost server, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and update mechanisms for user profiles and channel memberships.

classes.name: LocalCacheUserStore
classes.description: A cache layer for user data, managing in-memory caches and cache invalidation for user profiles and channel memberships.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateScheme
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation messages for user profile cache based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateProfilesInChannel
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation messages for profiles in a channel.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateAllProfiles
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation messages for all user profiles.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears all caches related to user profiles and channel memberships.

methods.name: InvalidateProfileCacheForUser
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific user profile.

methods.name: InvalidateProfilesInChannelCacheByUser
methods.description: Invalidates cached profiles in channels for a specific user.

methods.name: InvalidateProfilesInChannelCache
methods.description: Invalidates cached profiles in a specific channel.

methods.name: GetAllProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves all user profiles, using cache if options match default parameters.

methods.name: GetAllProfilesInChannel
methods.description: Retrieves all user profiles in a channel, optionally from cache.

methods.name: GetProfileByIds
methods.description: Retrieves user profiles by IDs, utilizing cache and handling invalidations.

methods.name: UpdateFailedPasswordAttempts
methods.description: Updates failed password attempts for a user and invalidates cache.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile by ID, checking cache first, then fetching from store.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple user profiles by IDs, utilizing cache and fetching missing entries from store.
